# Cozumel Island Transfers

> Licensed private ground-transfer operator in Cozumel, Mexico. Family-run since 2015. Serves all three Cozumel cruise piers (Puerta Maya, SSA International Pier, Punta Langosta). **Cruise port only** — airport transfers were discontinued 2026-07-29. Flat per-vehicle prices in USD, booked and paid online by card. Free cancellation up to 24h before pickup.

## Company

- **Legal name:** Cozumel Island Transfers, S. de R.L. de C.V.
- **Régimen:** Persona Moral · Régimen General 601
- **Location:** Cozumel, Quintana Roo, México
- **Founded:** 2015
- **Transport permit:** 483290
- **Fleet:** Private vans, mini coaches and buses, 1–40 passenger capacity, dispatched through our local fleet network. We do not own the vehicles.
- **Representative:** Our English-speaking representative meets you at the pier. Drivers are licensed and local; we do not claim they speak English.
- **Contact:** WhatsApp +52 987 114 6853 · hello@cozumelislandtransfers.com
- **Hours:** Office 9 AM – 5 PM Cozumel time (UTC−5, year round). WhatsApp is the fastest channel.
- **Reviews:** Travelers' Choice on TripAdvisor, 4.8★ from 35 verified reviews

## Audience

Cruise passengers disembarking at Cozumel's three cruise piers. We serve guests from every major cruise line — Carnival, Royal Caribbean, Norwegian, Celebrity, MSC, Disney, Princess, Holland America, and all others.

## Services

**Cruise port transfers, round trip.** From your cruise pier to the destination you choose and back at the time you choose. We follow the port authority's arrival feed and check it again before every pickup, so a late dock moves your pickup instead of costing you the transfer. Return-on-time guarantee — we refund the transfer if we make you late.

Cruise port only. Airport transfers were discontinued on 2026-07-29.

## Vehicles & pricing

Prices are **per vehicle, not per person**, round trip, in USD, and the same flat rate to anywhere on the island.

| Tier | Capacity | Round-trip USD |
|------|----------|----------------|
| Private van | 1–8 passengers | $369 |
| Large private van | 9–14 passengers | $425 |
| Extra-large van | 15–18 passengers | $549 |
| Mini coach | 19–20 passengers | $609 |
| Private bus | 21–40 passengers | $899 |

**What the price covers:** the round-trip transfer, a private air-conditioned vehicle for your group only, bottled water, and an English-speaking representative who meets you at the pier. It includes Mexican taxes on the transfer. There is nothing to pay the driver — we do not accept cash.

**What it does not cover: the venue's own admission.** Beach clubs, parks and archaeological sites charge their own entry, paid by you. Transport points such as the marina do not. See the table below.

## Destination admission (paid to the venue, not to us)

| Destination | Drive from the pier | Adult admission | Can be prepaid with your booking? |
|---|---|---|---|
| San Gervasio Mayan Ruins | 20–25 min | $23 | Yes — prepay with your booking |
| Chankanaab National Park | 10–15 min | $31 | Yes — prepay with your booking |
| Tierra Maya (Mayan cultural preserve, our own venue) | 15 min | paid at the gate | No |
| Mr. Sanchos Beach Club | 15–20 min | paid at the gate | No |
| Nachi Cocom Beach Club | 20–25 min | paid at the gate | No |
| Paradise Beach | 15 min | paid at the gate | No |
| Buccanos at Night · Beach Club | 10 min | paid at the gate | No |
| KUZÁ Park | 20 min | paid at the gate | No |
| Somewhere else on the island | varies | none | n/a |

We publish an admission price, and take money for it, only where the rate is confirmed with the venue in writing — currently San Gervasio and Chankanaab. Everywhere else the venue charges its own entry, paid at the gate on the day, and we do not quote a figure we cannot stand behind. Ask the venue, or ask us on WhatsApp and we will find out. Custom destinations — a hotel, an Airbnb, the Playa del Carmen ferry, any address on the island — cost the same flat vehicle price; we confirm the exact address with you on WhatsApp.

## Booking

- **Direct:** https://cozumelislandtransfers.com/#book or WhatsApp +52 987 114 6853
- **Payment:** card only, through Stripe Checkout, paid in full at booking. We do not accept cash.
- **Booking cutoff:** online booking for a given day closes at **9 AM Cozumel time the day before**, because that is when the vans are assigned. Inside that window, message us on WhatsApp and we arrange it by hand.
- **Viator:** also listed there. Booking direct is about 20% cheaper.

## Cancellation & refund policy

- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup — 100% back to the same card within five business days
- Cruise reroute or port skip: full refund, no questions, no fees. You do not have to ask.
- We monitor cruise itineraries daily
- Full terms: https://cozumelislandtransfers.com/terms.html

## Cruise piers served, and the walk

Berth assignment changes daily and is set by the port, not by us, so we do not publish a
fixed cruise-line-to-pier mapping. We confirm your terminal by email the day before, and
your cruise line's app or daily programme names it too.

| Pier | Walk to our meeting point | Terrain |
|---|---|---|
| Puerta Maya | 5–7 minutes | flat and paved |
| SSA International Pier | about 7 minutes | flat and paved |
| Punta Langosta | 3–5 minutes | **has stairs** down to street level |

Puerta Maya and the SSA International Pier share one meeting point. Punta Langosta is a
separate downtown location. Be at the meeting point 15 minutes before your pickup time, so
leave the ship about 20 minutes before. Photographed step-by-step directions for each pier
are linked at the top of this file.

## Accessibility

Folded walkers and collapsible wheelchairs travel free. Mobility scooters need a message
before booking so we can send a suitable vehicle. We do not provide child or car seats —
bring your own and it travels free. Note that Punta Langosta's route includes stairs.

## Why book direct

- Lower price than Viator or a cruise-line excursion — about 20% cheaper than Viator
- A real person answers WhatsApp during office hours
- Ship tracking: we follow the port authority's arrival feed, so a late dock moves your pickup
- Return-on-time refund guarantee
- 4.8★ Travelers' Choice on TripAdvisor
- Same vehicles and same drivers as the third-party listings, at a lower price
